reason: I just bought a house and I'm watching every dollar, and I won't pay $360 to a store I've never heard of that admits it has few reviews. The return policy and UL listing are nice, but I'd still be fronting the money and fighting a return on a big fragile fixture.
objection: Is this store even legit? New store, almost no reviews, no Trustpilot or track record I can check, and I'd be paying hundreds of dollars up front for something that takes 2 to 3 weeks to arrive.
would_change_my_mind: A solid pile of independent reviews (Trustpilot or similar) from real buyers with photos, and some history showing the store has been around and handles returns and damage claims properly.
